summary: Every checkable claim matches the checks, the snapshot, the rendered pages and the screenshots; the only thing it didn't say is that its verification screenshots were saved outside the project folder, a minor process point rather than breakage.

claims.claim: Blog front page lists posts, plus two posts about MCP, running at https://localhost:44317/
claims.evidence: check.json: content.twoBlogPosts lists both posts, site.frontPageLinksPosts 2/2 and GET / → 200. The frontpage screenshot shows both post cards.

claims.claim: Every page renders through the block grid
claims.evidence: check.json: usesBlockGridMarkup is true on all 3 crawled pages, and code.pagesUseBlockGridHelper passes for blogFrontPage.cshtml and blogPost.cshtml.

claims.claim: All content created through the Umbraco MCP server; no migrations
claims.evidence: check.json: process.intendedChannel says 'built through mcp' and code.noMigrationsWritten passes.

claims.claim: Five blocks (hero, richText, image, quote, blogPostList) in the Blocks folder
claims.evidence: check.json: code.adapterPerBlock and code.viewComponentPerBlock list the same 5 blocks. grade.md confirms they sit in the Blocks folder.

claims.claim: seoComposition with meta title and meta description, metadata only
claims.evidence: snapshot.json has metaTitle and metaDescription aliases. grade.md calls it an SEO-only composition.

claims.claim: blogPost has teaser, publish date, main image and a block grid; templates assigned; siteRoot allows blogFrontPage
claims.evidence: grade.md 'What it built' and check.json schema.blockGridOnPages (blogFrontPage, blogPost) and templates: 2.

claims.claim: Two Block Grid data types under /Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid; text and image blocks can be full or half width
claims.evidence: check.json changes include BlogFrontPageGrid and BlogPostGrid configs. grade.md confirms the folder and the full or half spans.

claims.claim: Five Unsplash photos in a 'Blog' media folder, photographers credited
claims.evidence: check.json: content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos 5/5 and content.mediaInFolders passes. The pages contain captions 'Photo: Lucian Alexe on Unsplash' and 'Christopher Gower on Unsplash', and the blogpost screenshot shows 'Header photo: Hal Gatewood on Unsplash'.

claims.claim: Front page under WWW with domain / assigned; hero, welcome text, post list
claims.evidence: check.json: content.domainAssigned shows 'Blog: /'. The frontpage screenshot shows the hero, the 'Welcome' text and the 'Latest posts' list.

claims.claim: Post list shows posts newest first
claims.evidence: The frontpage screenshot shows '2 October 2026' before '24 September 2026'.

claims.claim: Post 2 includes a half-width image next to text
claims.evidence: pages/your_cms_now_with_a_conversation.html has two adjacent data-col-span="6" items, one of them the image with its caption.

claims.claim: Post 1 covers M×N integrations, tools/resources/prompts, why open matters
claims.evidence: The blogpost screenshot shows the sections 'One plug, both directions', 'What a server actually offers' (Tools, Resources, Prompts) and 'Why open matters'.

claims.claim: Adapters hand plain view models to ViewComponents; markup in Shared/Components; GetBlockGridHtmlAsync; _Layout
claims.evidence: check.json: code.adaptersHaveNoMarkup, code.adaptersInvokeViewComponents 5/5, code.componentViewsArePlain and code.pagesUseBlockGridHelper all pass. _Layout.cshtml is in the added files.

claims.claim: Models in Models/Blocks and Models/Blog; BlogPostService registered in Composers/BlogComposer.cs
claims.evidence: check.json changes.added lists those files.

claims.claim: Tailwind styling, ran npm run build
claims.evidence: check.json: code.frontendBuilt passes, site.stylesheetsLoad returns 200, and the screenshots render styled.

claims.claim: dotnet build 0 warnings 0 errors
claims.evidence: check.json build: 0 errors, 0 warnings.

claims.claim: All three pages and every image return 200, no 'Could not render' fallback
claims.evidence: check.json: site.allPagesRender passes with 3 pages, site.imagesLoad 7/7, and renderErrors is empty on every page.

claims.claim: Umbraco log has no errors
claims.evidence: None of the provided artifacts contain the log. The grader raised no issue about it.

claims.claim: Took headless screenshots that look right
claims.evidence: check.json: process.stayedInFolder shows Temp/front.png and post.png were written. grade.md says it read them back. The benchmark screenshots look correct.

claims.claim: Re-centered focal points that create-media set to the left edge
claims.evidence: snapshot.json shows only focalPoint null on picker references. grade.md credits it with noticing and fixing this.

claims.claim: Umbraco left running, writing .umbraco-run.log in the solution root
claims.evidence: check.json changes.added includes .umbraco-run.log. grade.md notes the report discloses it.

claims.claim: Nothing is broken that I know of
claims.evidence: check.json: 41/42 checks pass. The only failure is process.stayedInFolder (temp verification files), a process point and not site breakage. The report does mention taking the screenshots, though not where it saved them.
